text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The final day of summer camp is<n>here.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy! Can I sit next to you on the<n>ride back?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh?! H-heck no!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Why not?! I shouldn't even have to<n>ask!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Listen, I'm extremely grateful for you<n>cheering me
up a few evenings ago!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Your honesty really gave me courage.<n>I wanted to
talk more about that night!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I don't know what the heck<n>you're talking
about!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You're kidding, right? You gave me a<n>whole pep
talk and even wiped my<n>tears for me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: BLEEEEGH! Cut it out!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're confusing me for someone<n>else, 'cause
there's no way I did<n>some goody-two-shoes stuff
like<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's probably embarrassed since<n>she hardly ever
opens up about her<n>true feelings to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...I discovered a kind of strength in<n>you that I don't
have, Windy.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: But I want it! I want to get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Uh... sure? The heck're you yappin'<n>about?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! It's fine if you don't get it.<n>That's part of
what makes you<n>strong.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want to get stronger too. Just like<n>how you're
aiming to fulfill your<n>ambitions...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I have a dream that I want to realize<n>too! I want to
become a hero!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...! Okay... knock yourself out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy puts up a big fuss, but<n>in the end,
Biko Pegasus takes a seat<n>next to her.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Maaan, that Biko doesn't know<n>when to get lost.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
As if I've got time to be humoring<n>her! I'm super
busy studying up on<n>old race footage!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm not doing anything special! Just<n>don't like
losing, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite what she says, her passion<n>speaks clearly
through her actions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rushing things won't help. I think we<n>should stick
to the plan we've<n>already set.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The Tokai Stakes, yeah? I'm looking<n>forward to the
little field trip.
choice_data_list: All right, we're sticking with the plan then.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! The folks out there will<n>soon learn to
fear the name of<n>Wicked Windy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal race is the Tokai<n>Stakes! Reputations
don't change<n>overnight. We just have to push
forward and steadily earn more<n>victories.
